topic: 2021 GasGas MC 250F: no handlebar map switch, traction or launch control in standard trim
statement: Unlike its KTM and Husqvarna siblings, the 2021 GasGas MC 250F owner's manual describes no handlebar map switch, traction control, launch control or quickshifter - the engine runs a single fixed map; the only rider-adjustable engine response in the manual is the swappable throttle-grip guide plate (grey = slower opening, black = standard).
notes: Absence verified by searching the full manual text for mapping, map select, traction control, launch control and quickshifter (no hits); the 2023 MC 450F manual, by contrast, does describe mapping.
